description: Paid ($0.030/call): Transcribe audio to text with the gpt-transcribe model. Provide a URL to an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, etc.) and get back the transcript. Add diarize:true for speaker labels, word timestamps and a language confidence score (the scribe-v2 model, same price). No API key needed; pay per call via x402.

diarize.description: true: transcribe with the scribe-v2 model and add speaker labels and word timestamps (`words`, `speakers`) and `language_confidence` (0 to 1, the model's confidence in the detected language). Same price and cap. Default false

language.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr') for better accuracy

url.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, webm)

name: audio.transcribe
title: Speech-to-text
